conclusion: The actual common-Poisson identity preserves raw zero-2V+U exactly but does not pay it. Pinned finite W-zero/U-zero covariance and V-zero=U-zero identities are genuine unconditional algebraic reuse material. The complete provider zero-mode payment explicitly requires SW on paired beta, which the actual U-side common-smoothing route does not have; its U/V logarithmic remainder payment also requires paired beta at short C.2 scale. No complete direct actual cancellation/payment endpoint was established.

selected_declarations.name: MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart
selected_declarations.complete_source_header: def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ
selected_declarations.primitive_source_definition:
def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          ((d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) *
            CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) else 0)

selected_declarations.primitive_source_definition:
def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          (∑' h : ℤ, CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency
            (d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1))
            ((ComplexCRT.residue (complexFactorModulus l.1)
              (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 d.residue : ℝ) /
                (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) h).re
      else 0 : ℝ)

selected_declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem MediumAtom.complexDispersionW_commonSmooth_eq_zero_add_nonzero
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}

selected_declarations.name: MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity_with_commonPoisson
selected_declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity_with_commonPoisson
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    ((∑ n ∈ d.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.commonSmoothWeight n * ‖d.complexCenteredRow n‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (d.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart -
        2 * (d.complexDispersionV d.commonSmoothCarrier d.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) +
          (d.complexDispersionU d.commonSmoothCarrier d.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ)) +
        d.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_norm_sq_le_commonSmoothDispersion
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}

def wGCDData (q r N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : WGCDData :=
  let d := N₁.gcd N₂

selected_declarations.name: smoothWMain
selected_declarations.complete_source_header: def smoothWMain (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ
selected_declarations.primitive_source_definition:
def smoothWMain (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (M * dyadicCutoffMass) *
    ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, ∑ r ∈ reducedModuli Q a,
      (c q * c r / (q.lcm r : ℝ)) *
        ∑ n₁ ∈ N, ∑ n₂ ∈ N,
          if WCompatible q r n₁ n₂ then β n₁ * β n₂ else 0

selected_declarations.primitive_source_definition:
def smoothWNonzeroMode (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, ∑ r ∈ reducedModuli Q a,
    ∑ n₁ ∈ N, ∑ n₂ ∈ N,
      if WCompatible q r n₁ n₂ then
        (c q * c r * β n₁ * β n₂) * (∑' h : ℤ, wPoissonFrequency M a q r n₁ n₂ h).re
      else 0

theorem dispersionW_eq_smoothWMain_add_nonzeroMode
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, q ≠ 0) :

        (fun m ↦ scaledDyadicCutoff M m) β c a =
      smoothWMain M N Q β c a + smoothWNonzeroMode M N Q β c a

selected_declarations.name: betaCovariance
selected_declarations.complete_source_header: def betaCovariance (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) : ℝ
selected_declarations.primitive_source_definition:
def betaCovariance (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b ∈ betaReducedResidues (q.gcd r),
    (betaResidueMass N β q (q.gcd r) b -
      coprimeMass N β q / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ)) *
    (betaResidueMass N β r (q.gcd r) b -
      coprimeMass N β r / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ))

selected_declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem beta_covariance_identity
    (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) {q r : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ b ∈ betaReducedResidues (q.gcd r),
      betaResidueMass N β q (q.gcd r) b *
      betaResidueMass N β r (q.gcd r) b) -
        coprimeMass N β q * coprimeMass N β r / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℝ) =
      betaCovariance N β q r

theorem smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_eq_betaCovariance
    (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)

      (M * dyadicCutoffMass) *
        ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, ∑ r ∈ reducedModuli Q a,
          (c q * c r / (q.lcm r : ℝ)) * betaCovariance N β q r

selected_declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_coprimeAP_lcm
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (j κ : ℕ)
    {T L E : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊)
    (hQ : Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊) (β c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hβ : ∀ n ∈ N, |β n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) (a : ℤ)
    (hAP : ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ δ : ℕ, δ ∣ q → 0 < δ →
      ∀ b ∈ betaReducedResidues δ,
        |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β δ (q / δ) b| ≤
          E * (fouvryTau κ (q / δ) : ℝ)) :
    |smoothWMain M N Q β c a - smoothUMain M N Q β c a| ≤
      2 * |M * dyadicCutoffMass| * E *
        (T * (1 + Real.log T) ^ (k - 1)) *
        (1 + Real.log L) ^ (2 * (j * (κ + 1)) ^ 2 + 1)

selected_declarations.name: smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_SW

theorem smoothWMain_sub_smoothUMain_abs_le_SW
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (j κ B : ℕ)
    {T L C : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (M : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊)
    (hQ : Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊) (β c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hβ : ∀ n ∈ N, |β n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) (a : ℤ)
    (hSW : ∀ d h : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < h → ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime d →
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy N β d h b| ≤
        C * T * (fouvryTau κ h : ℝ) / Real.log (2 * T) ^ B) :
    |smoothWMain M N Q β c a - smoothUMain M N Q β c a| ≤
      2 * |M * dyadicCutoffMass| * C * T ^ 2 *
        ((1 + Real.log T) ^ (k - 1) *
          (1 + Real.log L) ^ (2 * (j * (κ + 1)) ^ 2 + 1) /

selected_declarations.name: alpha_sq_mul_smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
selected_declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem alpha_sq_mul_smoothWU_SWFamily_log_payment
    {ι : Type*} {κ k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (j A : ℕ)
    {T : ι → ℝ} {N : ι → Finset ℕ} {β : ι → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hSW : BetaCoprimeSWFamily κ T N β)
    (hT : ∀ i, 1 ≤ T i) (hN : ∀ i, N i ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T i⌋₊)
    (hβ : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N i, |β i n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ i : ι, ∀ M L : ℝ,
      1 ≤ M → 1 ≤ L → M * T i ≤ x → L ≤ x → x ^ ε ≤ T i →
      ∀ S Q : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, M ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M) →
      Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊ → ∀ α c : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, |α m| ≤ (fouvryTau ℓ m : ℝ)) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) → ∀ a : ℤ,
      (∑ m ∈ S, α m ^ 2) *
        |smoothWMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a - smoothUMain M (N i) Q (β i) c a| ≤
        x ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ A

theorem signedError_sq_le_nonzeroMode_c2
    {ι : Type*} {κ k ℓ j : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (A : ℕ)
    {T : ι → ℝ} {N : ι → Finset ℕ} {β : ι → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hSW : BetaCoprimeSWFamily κ T N β) (hT : ∀ i, 1 ≤ T i)
    (hN : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N i, T i ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * T i)
    (hβ : ∀ i, ∀ n ∈ N i, |β i n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ i : ι, ∀ M L : ℝ,
      1 ≤ M → 1 ≤ L → 4 * M * T i = x →
      x ^ ε ≤ T i → T i ≤ x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → L ≤ x ^ (5 / 9 : ℝ) →
      ∀ S Q : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, M ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M) →
      Q ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊L⌋₊ → ∀ α c : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ m ∈ S, |α m| ≤ (fouvryTau ℓ m : ℝ)) →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau j q : ℝ)) → ∀ a : ℤ,
      signedError S (N i) Q α (β i) c a ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ m ∈ S, α m ^ 2) * smoothWNonzeroMode M (N i) Q (β i) c a +
          x ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ A

theorem dispersionUV_smooth_c2_dyadic_log_payment
    {i k j : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (A : ℕ) :

      T ≤ x ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → L ≤ x ^ (5 / 9 : ℝ) →

def smoothWUSmallDelta (M D : ℝ) (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ :=

def BetaCoprimeSWFamily {ι : Type*} (κ : ℕ) (T : ι → ℝ)
    (N : ι → Finset ℕ) (β : ι → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧

def wGCDData (q r N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : WGCDData :=
  let d := N₁.gcd N₂
  let δ := q.gcd r
  { d := d, d₁ := supportedPart (N₁ / d) d
    δ := δ, δ₁ := supportedPart (q / δ) δ, δ₂ := supportedPart (r / δ) δ
    k₁ := coprimePart (q / δ) δ, k₂ := coprimePart (r / δ) δ
    n₁ := coprimePart (N₁ / d) d, n₂ := N₂ / d }
